summary: Frontend-only verification of the KNDatePicker / KNMonthPicker sweep + Fixed Assets residu validation on the static build (admin@kainnusantara.id, scope-pick-ent_ksc). ZERO console/page errors and no blank screens across every screen visited. FIXED ASSETS (all PASS): fa-period-input is KNMonthPicker rendering as a BUTTON showing 'September 2026'; fa-period-input-popover opens with year nav (prev-year 2026->2025, next-year back to 2026, fa-period-input-year label) and 12 month buttons; picking fa-period-input-month-09 sets the value and closes the popover; 'Jalankan Penyusutan' POSTed {"period":"2026-09","entity_id":"ent_ksc"} to /api/fixed-assets/run-depreciation and succeeded ('Penyusutan 2026-09: 2 aset diposting (Rp 3.437.500), 0 dilewati.') - no format error. asset-date-input is KNDatePicker (BUTTON, default today 'Jum, 04 Sep 2026', NOT clearable - no -clear button), popover opens ABOVE the modal (elementFromPoint at popover centre resolves inside the popover) and picking a day set 'Sel, 08 Sep 2026'. Residu live validation PASS: cost 10.000.000 + salvage 12.000.000 -> asset-salvage-input gets class '!border-[#D14343]', asset-salvage-input-preview shows 'Rp 12.000.000 · Residu harus lebih kecil dari harga perolehan', add-asset-submit-btn DISABLED; lowering salvage to 1.000.000 removes the hint and re-enables submit. Saved asset POST payload acquisition_date '2026-08-15' (picked via previous-month + day 15) and the new row KSC/FA-00003 shows '15 Agu 26' -> ISO round-trip correct. dispose-date-input is also KNDatePicker (BUTTON 'Jum, 04 Sep 2026', popover opens inside the dispose modal). ESC REGRESSION PASS: ESC inside an open calendar popover closed only the popover, the parent modal stayed open (verified in add-asset-dialog, contract-form-modal and the landed-cost modal). KNDatePicker verified LIVE as BUTTON + working popover + Indonesian label on: pr-needed-by (also -clear empties it back to 'Pilih tanggal'), price-validfrom-input / price-validuntil-input, contract-valid-from / contract-valid-to, blanket-valid-from (not clearable) / blanket-valid-until (clearable + hint 'Kosongkan = tanpa kadaluarsa'), lc-voucher-date / lc-due-date, vb-bill-date / vb-due-date, it-faktur-date, rfq-needed-date, pl-input-from / pl-input-until, cpl-input-from / cpl-input-until, interco-contract-valid-from (clearBtn=0) / interco-contract-valid-to (placeholder 'Tanpa batas'), veh-log-tanggal (not clearable, defaults today), ca-tanggal / ca-period-from / ca-period-to, stl-line-date-0. BACKEND ROUND-TRIP PASS on 3 saves: PR-00010 POST needed_by_date '2026-09-22'; supplier price entry POST valid_from '2026-09-11' -> list row shows '11 Sep 2026 – ∞'; vehicle log POST tanggal '2026-09-17' -> table row KSC/VHL-00001 shows '17 Sep 2026'. Repo-wide grep confirms NO remaining <input type="date"> in any of the in-scope files (remaining 49 native date inputs are all out of scope: finance reports/CashFlow/FinancialStatements/JournalEntry, HR, POS/mobile, R&D, CRM ARReceipt, admin PO/audit).

action_items: OPTIONAL (low): add the shared useEscapeClose/overlayDismiss helper to ContractFormModal, the Pricelist/Customer set-price modals and ContraBonCreateWizard - still the only class of defect blocking automated navigation.
OPTIONAL (cosmetic): make asset-cost-input / asset-salvage-input placeholders human-readable (e.g. '10.000.000') instead of raw digits.
Cleanup test data created this iteration (see seed_data_creation).
critical_code_review_comments: KNDatePicker/KNMonthPicker are small, single-responsibility and correctly emit ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' / 'YYYY-MM'; the trigger is a real <button type="button"> so it never submits a parent form, and the clear button calls preventDefault - no issues found.

KNMonthPicker keeps `year` in local state initialised from the value only on mount: if the parent later changes `value` to a different year the popover still shows the old year. Harmless today (value is only changed from inside the picker) but worth a useEffect sync if the period ever becomes controlled externally.

49 native <input type="date"> remain outside the requested scope (finance report ranges cf-start/fs-pl-start/eq-start/prof-start/cons-asof, je-date, pv-due-date, HR leave/overtime/attendance/employee dob, POS & mobile checkout, R&D sample dates, ar-receipt-date, po-amend-eta, delivery-date-input, audit filters). If the goal is 'no browser pickers anywhere', these are the remaining backlog.

Because several modals ignore ESC, re-login/reload between modal groups instead of trying to click the sidebar.
rca_of_the_issue: No defect found in the requested work. The KNDatePicker popover is rendered through Radix PopoverContent (portal + its own dismiss layer), which is why ESC inside a calendar consumes the key and leaves the parent modal untouched, and why elementFromPoint at the popover centre always lands inside the popover (no z-index clipping) even inside z-[170] modals. The only remaining friction is unrelated and pre-existing: ContractFormModal / set-price modals / ContraBonCreateWizard shells never registered an ESC or backdrop handler, so their overlay traps navigation.
